children: We started with the story rather than the surface. The existing brand had credible material truth: eucalyptus Lyocell, softness, thermoregulation and a real following in the DACH market. Rather than replace that foundation, we reframed its role. The product would remain the proof. Care would become the meaning. From there, the work expanded beyond colour and interface into a complete brand world — photography, motion, packaging, editorial language, digital experience and customer touchpoints. The goal was not to create more assets. It was to define a set of behaviours that could make Cozy Heaven feel coherent wherever it appeared.
